transcript: I wanted to learn how to create AI powered applications, so I decided to create something around a problem I actually deal with. I was recently hiring editors and designers for my team, but screening those resumes can take a lot of time. So, I built Hire AI. I used the skills I learned from IBM SkillsBuild and the hands-on experience with IBM Bob, and I built an AI assistant that helps organize and surface resumes based on a specific requirement I'm looking for, like strong editing experience for editors and a solid portfolio for designers. Instead of manually sorting through applications myself, I can quickly review the most relevant candidates. And of course, the final hiring decision always stays with me. But honestly, the real win wasn't automating hiring, it was taking AI concepts and turning them into a working application that solves a real problem. And that's what I think is the most exciting thing about learning AI. If you want to turn what you're learning into something real, check out IBM SkillsBuild with the link in the bio and start building.
caption:
I built a tool to solve my hiring problem 🔥

#IBMPartner
